name: provenance-reports-actual-n
why: PRD §7: 'Provenance reports actual N, never intended N.' AGENTS.md names the failure directly: 'the denominator silently falls back to the numerator and every line reads a clean N of N.' Ticket 048 R4-2 found a live instance — a rep whose ledger POST went unacknowledged vanishes from the denominator entirely, so 3 reps run and the line reads '2 of 2'.

must_include.reason: the rep that ran must remain in the denominator even when its row never landed
